name: ClickSyncr for Drip – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms & Formidable
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Drip connects Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator to Drip. Each configured form sends its submissions to the Drip campaign you choose, with no code required.

Drip

Connected forms send their submissions to Drip. “Drip” is a trademark of its respective owner. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Drip. Read more in the Drip privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “ClickSyncr for Drip”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Edit a form in any supported builder and open its ClickSyncr Drip settings.
  4. Paste your Drip API token, choose a campaign, and map your fields (email is required). Save.
